assessment.headline: DAY 40. THE WAR PAUSES. 2-week ceasefire announced. Pakistan brokered. Hormuz reopening. Talks Friday in Islamabad.
assessment.body:
After 39 days of escalating war, the most consequential breakthrough yet:

🟢 Trump announced a 2-WEEK CEASEFIRE on Truth Social late Tuesday: 'subject to the Islamic Republic of Iran agreeing to the COMPLETE, IMMEDIATE, and SAFE OPENING of the Strait of Hormuz, I agree to suspend the bombing and attack of Iran for a period of two weeks. This will be a double sided CEASEFIRE!'

Iran accepted. FM Araghchi confirmed: 'For a period of two weeks, safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz will be possible via coordination with Iran's Armed Forces and with due consideration of technical limitations.' Iran's Supreme National Security Council declared victory and said Trump accepted Iran's 10-point plan as 'general framework' for negotiations.

A US Defense official confirmed: 'the ceasefire is now in effect and the US has suspended all strikes.'

PAKISTAN BROKERED THE DEAL:
• PM Shehbaz Sharif + Field Marshal Asim Munir convinced Trump in last-minute calls
• Trump cited their requests directly: 'they requested that I hold off the destructive force being sent tonight to Iran'
• Peace talks begin Friday April 10 in Islamabad
• VP Vance likely leading US delegation
• Vance + Witkoff had advised Trump to accept; Graham, Netanyahu, Saudi, UAE urged rejection
• Sharif called it 'a sagacious gesture' — 'both parties have displayed remarkable wisdom'

MARKETS RIPPED HIGHER:
• US crude: $117 → $103 (-8% in minutes)
• Brent fell sharply
• S&P 500 futures +1.6%
• Nasdaq 100 futures +1.8%
• Dow futures +725 points
• Indian markets open in ~1 hour to expected massive gap-up

INDIA — STRATEGIC VINDICATION:
• 8 of 9 LPG carriers extracted BEFORE the ceasefire (Green Asha crossed Sunday)
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) already at Mangalore
• Jaishankar-Araghchi call earlier confirmed India 'supports ongoing efforts to stop war'
• 51 lakh LPG cylinders delivered Monday — supply held throughout
• 60 days fuel stock buffer never breached. Refineries >100%
• Pakistan brokered = India is quiet diplomatic backer
• Indian basket likely to drop sharply as oil crashes
• Sensex closed +800 Mon on ceasefire hope; Wed open expected to gap up massively
• Rupee likely to strengthen below 92
• 345 Indian fishermen also returned
• Only Jag Vikram still in Gulf — now safer to extract

BEFORE THE CEASEFIRE — TUESDAY ESCALATION:
In the hours BEFORE the deal, the situation looked catastrophic:
• Trump warned 'a whole civilization will die tonight'
• US struck Kharg Island oil export hub (90% of Iran's oil exports)
• Israel hit Sharif University of Technology + Rafi Niya synagogue (destroyed)
• 18 civilians killed in one Iranian province
• Iranian youth formed human chains around power plants
• Iran threatened to strike UAE AI center
• IAEA: strikes 250 feet from Bushehr operating reactor
• US gas $4.14/gallon (up 39% since war began)
• Saudi Aramco hiked Asia oil price to RECORD premium

THE CEASEFIRE IS FRAGILE:
• Only 14 days to negotiate permanent end
• Iran demands sanctions lift + reconstruction + permanent end
• Trump says US has 'met and exceeded all Military objectives'
• Israel + Lebanon included but Netanyahu reluctant
• Hezbollah did not sign on
• Eurasia Group: months to repair damaged refineries even with ceasefire
• Oil supply won't return to pre-war levels until late 2026 (EIA)
• If ceasefire breaks: Brent $145+, full re-escalation

WHAT TO WATCH:
1. Indian markets gap-up open at 9:15 AM IST
2. First commercial ship through Hormuz under ceasefire
3. Friday April 10: Islamabad talks begin
4. Whether Israel/Hezbollah cease fire holds
5. Iran's 10-point plan vs Trump's 15-point plan reconciliation

After 40 days, the war is paused. India enters this moment in the strongest possible position — strategic foresight, energy buffer, diplomatic neutrality, and an extracted fleet. The breakthrough vindicates India's careful all-sides approach from Day 1.
